title: Chase the Blockader
setup: Your pawn on e7 is held up by the rook on e8, the only black piece that can stop it from becoming a queen.
hint: The blockading rook has exactly one job. Attack it with something it cannot afford to trade itself for.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8}} attacks the blockader. {{Rxd8}} loses on the spot to exd8=Q+, and any other rook move lets the pawn through, so Black must give the rook up for the pawn. Remove the piece holding a passed pawn and the pawn is a queen.
